# KasmVNC offline packages

Bundled KasmVNC installers for offline Flatpak desktop sessions.

- Version: `1.4.0`
- Distro: Debian 13 (trixie) only
- Architectures: `amd64`, `arm64`

Files:

- `kasmvncserver_trixie_1.4.0_amd64.deb`
- `kasmvncserver_trixie_1.4.0_arm64.deb`

Upstream: https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC/releases/tag/v1.4.0
